proof.criterion: (1) The merges add nothing beyond the branch's diff and main's changes.
proof.command: git show --remerge-diff --stat <each merge>; per-file comparison of the revoke-path changes since b7709821 with main's daf71f53..c656fc4f

proof.criterion: (2) Every route from both sides is in routes_table.go, and this PR's test hook has its write class.
proof.surface: routes_table.go at the branch (78d58843), main (f93dd689) and the merge; package api tests on the pod's test Postgres
proof.command: Set comparison of route rows and writeClasses keys; go test -run 'TestRouteIndex|TestWriteRouteIndex|TestRoutesTable|TestEveryMutatingRouteIsClassed|TestAProjectScoped|TestADeploymentWriteIsRefused' ./internal/dispatch/api/
proof.observed: No route row of either side is lost, and the merge has no row that neither side has. writeClasses is the union of both sides plus POST /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/_test/newer-content: scopeProject. All 8 tests PASS.

proof.criterion: (3) The creation gate sits in pmdoc's single writer tail.
proof.surface: pmdoc/update.go at 920859be; docs.ApplyOps through a probe test, at head and in a scratch copy whose UpdateDocument skips writeDocument
proof.command: Grep of updateChildren and refuseUncreatable callers; probe TestZZProbeAnEditBatchCreatesNoUncreatableElement (future block staged as not creatable)
proof.observed: Update, UpdateHolding and UpdateDocument all end in writeDocument (refuseUncreatable, then updateChildren); writeDocument is the only non-recursive caller of updateChildren. At head and in the broken copy, the edit batch's insert is refused at parse ('reads typed block "future" but cannot write it yet'), and a replace writes escaped inline text only. UpdateDocument's gate is a second guard; losing it shows no consumer-visible defect, so this is not a finding.
proof.negativeControl: An insert holding the future block is refused, at head and in the broken copy.
